module: Render views of the Vehicle Editor's Static Editor. Each "Static Render View##N" window has two RenderViews (the main view and a small axes gizmo), in 3D or orthographic mode (Left -X, Right +X, Back -Y, Front +Y, Bottom -Z, Top +Z). The file handles the camera (keyboard movement, mouse), the grid drawn with the debugDrawer, the clickable axis arrows, the context menu and saving the views to settings/vehicleEditorStatic/staticRenderView.json. Other extensions (vePartTree) use it to get the mouse ray in the main view.
notes: Camera constants: base speed 5 in perspective and 2 in orthographic, "fast" multiplier 2.5; the grid is 10 m with 0.25 m cells.

The functions moveLeft/moveRight/moveForward/moveBackward(val) and setCameraSpeed(s) are meant to be called by keyboard actions (keybindings): val is the axis or key value (0 released, 1 pressed). setCameraSpeed(s) sets camSpeedMult = s * (2.5 - 1) + 1.

Views exist only while their window is open: a closed window destroys its RenderViews ("hacky way" according to the code); when leaving the static editor (onEditorHeadlessChange with enabled = false) the settings are saved and all views are destroyed.
Bug: the extension exports onDeserialize (without "d") whereas the engine calls onDeserialized; this hook is therefore ignored (it is empty anyway). onSerialize saves the settings and returns nil.
The "Mode: ..." text is drawn at the top left of each view by onPreRender via debugDrawer:drawTextAdvanced.

createRenderViewUI.desc: Creates a new render view (window + RenderViews): reuses the first entry whose window is hidden or deleted, otherwise creates a new entry, registers the window (400x600, vehicleEditor tool) if needed, shows it and saves the settings. Called by the View > Add View menu of veToolbar.

destroyAllRenderViews.desc: Destroys all RenderView objects (main and gizmo) of all views, without closing the ImGui windows. Called when leaving the editor.

getMainRenderViewMouseRay.desc: Returns the mouse ray in the main view of the hovered window (rv:getUnprojectedRayPosDir on the mouse coordinates converted into the viewport), or nil if no window is hovered or the mouse is not over the image.

returns.desc: result of RenderView:getUnprojectedRayPosDir(x, y), used by vePartTree as (ok, position, direction); nil if outside the view

moveBackward.desc: Sets the intensity of the backward camera movement (camMove.backward). Intended for a keyboard action.

moveForward.desc: Sets the intensity of the forward camera movement (camMove.forward).

moveLeft.desc: Sets the intensity of the leftward camera movement (camMove.left).

moveRight.desc: Sets the intensity of the rightward camera movement (camMove.right).

setCameraSpeed.desc: Sets the camera speed multiplier: camSpeedMult = s * (camFastSpeedMult - 1) + 1, with camFastSpeedMult = 2.5.

s.desc: 0 for normal speed, 1 for fast speed (2.5x)

onDeserialize.desc: Empty function exported under the name onDeserialize (probably a typo for onDeserialized, so never called by the engine).

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: reads the camera inputs, then for each view opens the window, creates the RenderViews as needed (getOrCreateView, enterFocusObjectsMode) and draws the content; destroys the RenderViews of a closed window.

dt.desc: time delta (s) used for camera movement

onEditorHeadlessChange.desc: Editor hook called when a headless tool is enabled or disabled. For the static editor, on exit: saves the settings and destroys the RenderViews.

enabled.desc: true on entering the tool, false on leaving

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor hook called at initialization: reloads the saved views from settings/vehicleEditorStatic/staticRenderView.json.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called every frame before rendering: draws the grid (debugDrawer), the view mode text and the axis arrows of each open view.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a Lua reload: saves the view settings to the settings file and returns nil.
